notes: app.fetch(request) with a Request made once per fixture; it returns synchronously here. Elysia has no single public matcher (static paths and its Memoirist tree are separate), so its context is included; handlers return one shared Response.
details: Elysia keeps static paths in a map and parameterized ones in a Memoirist tree, and only the compiled fetch function combines them, so the request is dispatched through app.fetch. With synchronous handlers it returns a Response, not a promise (the adapter throws if it ever gets a promise). Included besides the lookup: reading the path from the request URL, creating the context, decoding parameters. Each handler records the route and params and returns one Response created at start-up. On a miss Elysia builds its own 404 Response.
